motivation: Original LA001 guild-count model failed pooled whole-site CV; test whether within-study but separately assayed single-visit seed yield improves full-site prediction without fitting biological efficacy weights to field plants' seed outcomes.

single_visit_assay_schema.quality_weight: mean seed count per one experimental visit across all assigned assay flowers, counting no-fruit cases as 0; independent of 252 field-plant seed outcomes
single_visit_assay_schema.unweighted_unassayed_taxa: All other event taxon codes, including rare Honeybee n=2 and Ant n=1 in experimental assay, contribute 0 to this explicitly restricted calibrated numerator; 0 is absence of admitted assay calibration, NOT an ecological claim of zero efficacy.
single_visit_assay_schema.control: Bagged control n=21, 1 fruit/1 seed; retain in provenance but do not fit or adjust weights based on field outcomes.
single_visit_assay_schema.geographic_grain: Single-visit assay near site 1 (Waco) in 2015, not fully independent across four site-year arrays.
single_visit_assay_schema.genetic_grain: Assay is not paired to original 252 maternal field plants' S-locus genotype and does not measure compatible paternal identity; calibration is not genotype-specific.

field_exposure.exact_source_join: Original site × year × plant label through First Flower position table; 256 source field subjects, 252 with complete seed total.
field_exposure.filter: Exactly LA001 (exclude 38 positions logged 0 open flowers and 1 out-of-range position; exclude 4 incomplete 2015 observation sessions).
field_exposure.flower_hours: 0.5 × sum of number of open flowers at source position over complete site-year sessions
field_exposure.old_features: M1 = log1p((AH_visits + BF_visits)/source_flower_hours); M2=log1p(all valid visits/source_flower_hours)

evaluation.primary_endpoint: y=log1p(lifetime field seed total) same 252 source plants as LA001, no replacements
evaluation.model_M0: original LA001 ridge lambda 1, standardized train-only year/SC/year×SC/log1p(total flowers)/days flowering
evaluation.model_M1: original baseline + equal AH/BF effective guild visits
evaluation.model_M3: original baseline + fixed independently assayed single-visit quality_index, lambda 1, training-only standardization
evaluation.primary_comparator: M0 vs M3: pooled held-out site MSE gain = MSE_M0 − MSE_M3 (positive is improvement)
evaluation.secondary_comparator: M1 vs M3: pooled MSE_M1 − MSE_M3; do not rescue primary based on this comparison
evaluation.design: Leave one WHOLE site out incl. BOTH 2014 and 2015 in every fold; fixed 4 sites.
evaluation.rule: Bounded within-study gain only if pooled M0−M3 positive and at least 3 of 4 site-fold differences positive; otherwise mark no robust independent-calibration increment. Do not infer general/ecological law from any positive result.
evaluation.reported: All four fold n, M0, M1, M3 MSE and MAE, aggregate 252-plant pooled MSE and MAE, assay-source category n/fruit/seeds, exposure QC, decision and limitations. No individual-based p values or 4 studies.
evaluation.scaling: Use same original LA001 ridge fitting and only training fold to standardize; do not retune penalty or cutoffs.

stop_rules: Freeze current protocol file in GitHub commit before first M3 field seed predictive fit; do not revise based on results.
If any of 72 source assay records or 256 source plant joins fail, STOP and log source-only erratum.
Do not change biological group dictionary or weights after looking at field outcomes.
Do not drop Waco despite in-study effectiveness assay; acknowledge information sharing.
Do not reweight after observing 24-43, exclude difficult sites, or optimize any quality-guild subset.
If no improvement, preserve negative result and do not add new functional proxy as confirmation.
This does not test paternal compatibility, effective pollen receipt, viable offspring recruitment or natural urban/island convergence.
source_grain: One original research programme, one 2015 efficacy assay at Waco; effective visit rates in 121 sessions; population CV N=4 sites; causal generality absent
publication_firewall: No edits to original LA001/EGWE/EGWEE original main manuscripts, no original third-party Excel/ZIP to GitHub.
